lines.t: Let me tell you the truth from the top, from prophecy to glory, it's Gospel 101.
In the beginning, a promise written in stone, prophets proclaim a redeemer to be known.
Long awaited sunrise breaks through the night
Son of God sent to set all things right
Born of a virgin, bloodline the root
Word made flesh, wisdom taken its pursuit
No ordinary man, the fullness displayed
Messiah walking earth, it's sinless parade
Healed the sick, made the dead arise
Poured living water, opened blinded eyes
Bold in the temple, fierce with the truth Preach love for the lowly, condemned all abuse
Tempted and tested, darkness drew near He faced every trial, overcame every fear
Gasp of 101, this is the flow Crucified, risen, salvation bestowed
Son ascended, spirit poured from above All who call on his name, redeemed by love
One story, one king, one victory done
Great change, stand ready
When he comes
They hung him high, nails in his hands
Scorn and spit, world's violent demands
He bore the weight, every pain, every lie
Sin upon his shoulders as he bled to die
Darkness fell, the earth shook in grief
Three days later, he shattered belief Stone rolled back, no grave could hold
Risen and reigning, the story foretold He walked with his own, chose scars in his
side Promised to help him, the spirit is God
Ascended in glory, heaven received Now every heart willing may truly believe

Gospel 101, truth made known, spirit unleashed, hearts a living stone, first and the last, alpha and n, king on the clouds, about to descend, so sound the alarm, ignite and run, prepare for the day, kingdom will come.
Flames in his eyes, he returns as judge
Trumpets resound, thunders emerge
Separates we from chaff, truth from shame
Wrath for the wicked, glory for his name
Gathered his own, called to ascend
Redeemed of the ages, family and friend
Kingdom established, peace on the earth
Joyful creation, restored since new birth He's coming, he's coming, preparing the crowd
The king and the judge, blow trumpets loud Lift up your soul, let faith be stirred
Wake up the nations, hold on to his word God's but one on one
From the scroll to the beat From prophecy fulfilled to the resurrection seat
Spirit poured out, new covenant begun History divided, now the breakthrough's won
Gathered in glory, conquer, become
Alive in his kingdom, the gospel is done
Bow down and believe, let the truth be told
No power in hell, no silver, no gold
Enough to compare or erase what's begun
This is the greatest, gospel 101
Where you gonna stand?
Gospel 101
Who's holding your hand?
Gospel 101
Freedom is bound
Gospel 101
King, where's the town?
Gospel 101
